correctness.rationale: The Fock Toeplitz coefficient identity gives m=int_B dmu and b=int_B z dmu with the stated first-argument-linear inner product. Two distinct quadratic ball-defining functions differ by an affine L, with L(1_B1-1_B2)>0 on the positive-measure symmetric difference; identical (m,b) would force its weighted integral to vanish. The convex Ψ is finite and differentiable at all parameters because the quadratic zero set is negligible; true data give its gradient, and strict two-ball injectivity plus m>0 excludes any other minimizer. Shape differentiation at positive r yields r^n λ^(n+1) det Cov_ν(ω)>0, with uniform boundary support. Invariance of domain supplies the continuous-observation lower bound. The d=1 I0/I1/I2 angular Bessel formula specializes to the stated determinant; centered R² direct calculation at r=1.1 gives positive 0.08540916030474. Assumption r>0, known contrast, indexed (not spectral) data, and lack of global conditioning all matter.
